items.title: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
items.summary: Brand is told to expect a prison sentence "of some length" and faces more rape allegations, it can now be reported.

items.title: Watch: Met Police release Brand interview footage
items.summary: Brand was found guilty of one count of rape and three sexual assaults at Southwark Crown Court.

items.title: Henry Nowak’s killer has minimum term increased to 25 years by Court of Appeal
items.summary: Judges ruled Vickrum Digwa's original term was unduly lenient and refused his bid to have it cut.

items.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
items.summary: At least 21 flights across Europe are affected in what the UK government calls a "malicious hoax threat".

items.title: Bomb hoaxes: Messages reveal how threat was passed on by air traffic control
items.summary: BBC Verify has been analysing messages after flights across Europe were targeted by fake bomb threats - the second such incident this week.

items.title: California governor commutes death sentences for all 548 people on death row
items.summary: California has historically had the largest population of death row inmates in the US.

items.title: Interest rates hiked to 4% in first increase in over three years
items.summary: Most analysts expected the increase from 3.75% to 4%.

items.title: British man infected with Ebola in DR Congo arrives in UK for treatment
items.summary: The UK government says there are "well-established procedures for dealing with cases like this" and the risk to the public remains low.
